column1: # QA-R4 category "crash-regressions" (spec/04-quality-release.md): every sequence that publicly crashed a
# Vietnamese engine (spec/01-engine.md REG-01, REG-02, ENG-R411, ENG-R640, ENG-R641): Telex quz, QUZ, qqz,
# qutz, Quzhou; VNI qu0, qut0; tokens of 33, 64, 256 and 4,096 keys with and without marks; long runs of a
# single key; alternating tone keys. Source: public bug reports (the sequences, not any code). Each case
# must not trap, must keep every fuzz invariant (InvariantChecker) and, without a boundary, the restore
# toggle must give back exactly the keys typed. Minimised fuzz findings are added here when fixed (QA-R8).
# Long tokens use the repetition notation «X»×N (X written N times). Resources: the 13.9 fixtures.
# Columns: id, method, options, keys, expected (whole field), restore (- not checked), note.
# Keys: TSV escapes \s space, \n Return, \t Tab; markers ⌫ Backspace, ⎋ restore toggle, ⟲ reset.
